text.title: Main Character Morning
text.declared_genre: Alternative Hip-Hop / Acoustic Folk / Spoken Word
text.declared_mood: Sardonic, irritated, observant, comic, socially exhausted → softer, wiser, quietly hopeful
text.production_notes: Fingerpicked acoustic guitar with percussive street-corner groove, Lo-fi hip-hop drums: soft kick, brushed snare, palm taps, Warm upright-style bass, Sparse piano after second hook, Light room hiss for intimacy, Live and imperfect, sharp dropouts before punchlines, Final third adds soft harmonies and fuller bass while staying raw and uncluttered
text.vocal_notes: Intimate male vocal, Spoken-word rap verses with conversational pacing, clipped pauses, dry punchline timing, half-sung folk hook, Starts bitter and amused, gradually turns reflective, Close-mic delivery, slight rasp on sarcastic lines, whispered doubles on key phrases, Final hook warmer and more melodic
section_names: Intro – spoken | dry, close-mic | sparse guitar
Verse 1 – spoken rap | light guitar groove
Verse 3 – warmer spoken rap | piano enters lightly
Outro – spoken, slight smile | instruments fading
